verses.text: Of David. LORD, judge me, because I have lived an innocent life. I have trusted in the LORD without doubting.
Examine me, LORD, and test me. Look closely at my heart and mind.
I always keep your faithful love in front of my eyes. I live by your truth.
I do not sit with liars, and I do not spend time with people who pretend to be good.
I hate the meetings of evil people, and I will not sit with the wicked.
I wash my hands to show I am innocent, and I go around your altar, LORD,
singing songs of thanks out loud and telling about all the amazing things you have done.
LORD, I love the house where you live, the place where your glory stays.
Do not sweep me away with sinners. Do not take my life along with murderers,
whose hands are full of evil plans and bribes.
But I live an innocent life. Rescue me and be kind to me.
My feet stand on level ground. In the great gatherings I will praise the LORD.
